[quote=the_commonwealth_provisional_states;61345704]"Of course they won't be presented on the lawn, that would be bad manners hah," Julian says, leading them inside the white mansion as the press can be seen converging on the site

"And of course, the late arrival is of no concern to us." Julian responds.[/quote]

Cahit and the shah followed with Cahit waving to the press before rolling into the White Mansion, two aides for Cahit moved to flank the aged legislator as he extinguished his cigarette and proceeded to pop open a jar of olive tapenade that one of the aides had given him, a small spoon was produced.

Now, before we head any further into the house, I would like for to give the president and assembled guests a small gift of the tongue, he chuckled as the aide pulled a small package of crackers out of a briefcase and opened it in a napkin. Some olive spread from my own gardens, Cahit said, spooning the spread onto the crackers in heaping piles and offering them to the hosts and the shah.

fun fact: bubbas will randomly inhale construction materials and cause the material to safely spontaneously combust into up to 92 pieces(bubba great record for the most pieces of construction materials that were combusted in that process, and yes, it was counted). all bubbas, including Bubba The Great, have this habit. Bubbas usually spit out the combusted material into "combustics", a 1903 invention by a bubba named Kinthsgy Bugas(its a fact that no bubba will ever have the same name and the names are very wonky, as because Bubba the Great's Official name is Bubba Rhsy) the item is a portable and useful item that bubbas can spit out material into it. if not spit out after 4 hours, it can cause serious heath issues.
